faq.description: Everything you need to know about our home nursing services

q1.question: How can I book a nurse?
q1.answer: You can book a nurse through several methods: by filling out the online booking form, calling us at +420 773 629 123, via email at info@nius.cz, or through WhatsApp/Telegram. After booking, we will contact you to confirm the appointment time.

q2.question: How quickly can a nurse arrive?
q2.answer: Same-day visits, daily 8:00–21:00. We confirm the arrival time after you book. For planned visits, we recommend booking at least one day in advance.

q3.question: Do you visit hotels and Airbnb accommodations?
q3.answer: Yes. We regularly visit international patients staying in hotels, Airbnb, and short-term rentals throughout Prague. This is common for IVF patients and medical tourists needing post-surgery care. Just give us your accommodation address when booking.

q4.question: Do you work with IVF patients?
q4.answer: Yes. We have experience with IVF patients, including time-sensitive injections. We administer medication prescribed by your clinic, following their written instructions. We offer evening and weekend appointments within our daily hours of 8:00–21:00.

q5.question: Can you help with post-surgery recovery for medical tourists?
q5.answer: Yes, this is one of our specialties. We provide wound care, bandage changes, drain management, hygiene assistance, and escort services for patients recovering from plastic surgery, dental procedures, or other medical treatments in Prague. We understand the unique needs of international patients.

q6.question: Do I need a prescription for IV therapy?
q6.answer: Every infusion is prescribed by a doctor after a short health assessment, and the consultation is included in the price.

q7.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q7.answer: We accept cash (CZK or EUR), bank transfers, and card payments. Payment is collected after service. For package deals and subscription services, we can invoice monthly. Most insurance companies do not cover home nursing, but we provide receipts for potential reimbursement.

q8.question: Do you provide services outside of Prague?
q8.answer: We primarily operate in Prague, but we can provide services in the surrounding areas (up to 30 km) by individual arrangement. For travel outside Prague, we charge an additional fee of 10 CZK/km above the base rate.

q9.question: What are your operating hours?
q9.answer: We are available 7 days a week from 8:00 to 21:00. Call +420 773 629 123 or message us on WhatsApp. NIUS is not an emergency service. In an emergency call 155/112.

q10.question: Do you offer long-term care for disabled patients?
q10.answer: Yes, we provide daily assistance care for disabled and chronic patients, including hygiene support, medication administration, mobility assistance, and companionship. We offer flexible subscription packages for ongoing care needs.

q11.question: Are your services covered by insurance?
q11.answer: Currently, our services are not covered by health insurance. This is a direct payment by the client. Upon request, we will issue a receipt for payment that you can use for possible claims with your insurance company if you have additional insurance for premium healthcare.

q12.question: Do I need to prepare anything before the nurse arrives?
q12.answer: For the smoothest possible visit, we recommend: having your doctor's instructions ready (if you have them), ensuring a calm and clean space for the procedure, informing us in advance about your health condition and any allergies, and having your doctor's contact information handy.

items.question: Can you administer an infusion prescribed by my clinic?
items.answer: Yes, if your clinic has prescribed an infusion and provides written instructions, our nurses can administer it at your hotel or home in Prague. Please send us the instructions when you book.

items.question: What should I send you before the first visit?
items.answer: Your clinic's written instructions: the medication prescribed to you, the schedule and the way it should be administered. We plan the visit around them and confirm the arrival time after you book.

items.question: What time can you visit for my injections?
items.answer: We visit daily 8:00–21:00. If your clinic's schedule falls within these hours, we plan the visit around it. We confirm the arrival time after you book.

items.question: Can you come early in the morning or in the evening?
items.answer: We are available every day from 8:00 to 21:00, including weekends and holidays. Early-morning and evening visits within these hours can be arranged when you book.

items.question: Do you follow my clinic's instructions?
items.answer: Yes. Your fertility clinic prescribes and specifies your medication. We administer it following their written instructions, and we plan the visit around your schedule.

items.question: What medication can you administer?
items.answer: We administer medication prescribed by your clinic, following their written instructions. Both subcutaneous and intramuscular injections. We check the medication against the written instructions before every administration.

items.question: What IVF support services do you offer in Prague?
items.answer: We offer three core services: (1) Injection visits: medication prescribed by your clinic, following their written instructions; (2) Infusions prescribed by your clinic; (3) Vitamin and hydration IV drips, prescribed by a doctor after a short health assessment. All services are available at your hotel, Airbnb, or home in Prague.

items.question: How much do IVF injections cost in Prague?
items.answer: A single IVF injection visit costs 1,900 CZK, which includes the nurse visit, all sterile supplies, sharps disposal, and travel anywhere in Prague. For multiple injection visits during your cycle, we offer a 10% discount (1,710 CZK per visit). Infusions prescribed by your clinic are quoted individually. Contact us for a quote.

items.question: Can I add a vitamin and hydration IV drip during IVF?
items.answer: Ask your clinic first. If they agree, a vitamin and hydration IV drip can be combined with your injection visit. Every infusion is prescribed by a doctor after a short health assessment, and the consultation is included in the price. See our full IV drip menu for options and pricing.

items.question: What if I'm staying at a hotel?
items.answer: We visit all Prague hotels, Airbnb apartments, and short-term rentals. Just give us your hotel name, room number, and preferred time. The nurse arrives discreetly with all necessary supplies. No need to leave your room or arrange transport to a clinic.

llmSummary.title: IV Drip Therapy in Prague: Service Summary
llmSummary.content:
NIUS (Nurse in Prague) provides mobile IV drips across all Prague districts. A registered nurse comes to your hotel, Airbnb, home, or office with sterile equipment and administers your chosen IV drip on-site. Same-day visits, daily 8:00–21:00, including weekends and holidays. We confirm the arrival time after you book.

IV drip options include: Immunity Lite and Immunity Power (Vitamin C with fluids), Vitamin & Mineral Classic and Vitamin & Mineral Plus (vitamins, minerals and trace elements), CEO Recharge (B-complex vitamins, minerals and magnesium), Metabolic Reset, Pure Hydrate, Electrolyte Reset and Jet Lag Recovery (fluids and electrolytes), plus a B-Power vitamin B12 shot. IV drips start from 2,550 CZK; a vitamin shot starts from 1,650 CZK.

Every infusion is prescribed by a doctor after a short health assessment, and the consultation is included in the price. Languages spoken: English, Czech, Russian, Ukrainian. NIUS is not an emergency service. In an emergency call 155/112. Contact: +420 773 629 123 (phone/WhatsApp), info@nius.cz. Book through the order form on www.nius.cz or on WhatsApp. Company: Nius Services s.r.o., Prague, Czech Republic.

ourNurses.description: Every NIUS nurse holds a Czech medical license and has 5+ years of hospital experience. We work primarily with senior nurses from Prague hospitals who choose private practice for greater flexibility and patient connection.

items.q: Do I need a prescription for IV therapy?
items.a: Every infusion is prescribed by a doctor after a short health assessment, and the consultation is included in the price.

items.q: How fast can a nurse arrive?
items.a: Same-day visits, daily 8:00–21:00. We confirm the arrival time after you book.

items.q: What qualifications do your nurses have?
items.a: All nurses are registered and certified with hospital-grade training. They carry full medical equipment.

items.q: Can I get an IV drip at my hotel?
items.a: Yes. We visit hotels across Prague. Just give us the hotel name and room details when you book.

items.q: How long does an infusion take?
items.a: Most infusions take 35–75 minutes depending on the drip. Your nurse stays the entire time.
Yes. We administer medication prescribed by your clinic, following their written instructions. Evening injection visits are available.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Cash, bank transfer, and card payment. EUR accepted at current rate.
No minimum. Single visits, bundles, and monthly subscriptions are all available.
